title: Dropped Joomla article pages unpublish their exact native owner
steps: Run the native article drop suite against this branch, including the shipped JA Boxing kit and full write entry point.
expect: Dropped category-routed articles leave published lists even when no menu item opens their kit path.
Both native article and menu records are unpublished when applicable, with exact native state read-back.
A historical menu-only receipt cannot suppress the missing article write.
Kept shared owners, ambiguous bodies, invalid native state and plugin refusals remain blocked; archived and trashed articles are never restored.
Existing non-article stock-screen and menu behavior remains intact.
fence: Exact native article ownership declared by the kit; no guessed aliases, direct database writes or CSS hiding
